claims.statement: TAURON's current microinstallation workflow calls for an online notification with attachments including an installation diagram and, in applicable cases, technical characteristics and an NC RfG equipment certificate or equivalent evidence.
ENERGA-OPERATOR states that since 1 May 2022 conformity in the connection process requires a certificate from an accredited body and that it respects the shared verified inverter-certificate list.
TAURON's current process includes a separate storage-data attachment when a microinstallation design includes an electricity storage unit.

contrary_evidence: TAURON and other DSOs already provide online forms, instructions, and device-list shortcuts at no separate charge.
Some inverter models on the shared certified list need fewer attachments, reducing dossier complexity.
Polish microinstallation growth had already slowed materially by 2024 according to URE market reporting, so volume cannot be assumed to rise indefinitely.

economics.acquisition_route: Instrument the family business's authorized workflow, measure correction and preparation time, then pilot with 5 outside installers via wholesalers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated 5-9 year scenario: 450 installer accounts averaging 12,000 PLN annual revenue gives 5.4m PLN; at 32% EBITDA, 4x, and 75% ownership, equity value is about 5.18m PLN. Achieving low-touch wholesale distribution is the key assumption.
economics.founder_time: 12-20 hours per week because the first workflow and domain feedback are accessible through the family business
economics.gross_margin_basis: Form assembly and validation are automatable; rule maintenance and unusual grid cases create expert support cost
economics.payback: Customer payback hypothesis: saving 30-90 minutes and one correction cycle per project can justify 20-70 PLN per dossier; establish through before/after timing
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1,000-5,000 PLN setup, 300-1,000 PLN monthly, and 20-70 PLN per completed installation dossier
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every completed installation needs a dossier, device lists and forms change, and the project record can extend into warranty/service handover

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A maintained mapping of DSO form rules, device evidence, rejection reasons, and successful correction paths lowers error rates with every project
fingerprint.customer: Polish PV and energy-storage installers handling repeated microinstallation notifications across one or more DSOs
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Prove internally with the family installer, then distribute through PV wholesalers, inverter/storage distributors, installer groups, and white-label quoting platforms
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: DSO-aware data intake, device/certificate checks, diagram/form assembly, attachment validation, approval trail, and customer handover pack; hypothesis 300-1,000 PLN monthly plus 20-70 PLN per dossier
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Installer owner or operations manager pays a monthly seat/base fee plus a fee for each validated dossier
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Quote conversion to installation, inverter/storage selection, commissioning, DSO submission, missing-document request, or device certificate change

founder_fit: Strongest direct access advantage through the parents' seven-person renewable-energy company
Can validate on real authorized internal projects without speculative capital or outside commitments
Fits document automation, rule engines, and operational analytics
Founder can avoid public-facing sales by using wholesaler and software channels
risks: DSOs already provide free forms and online submission, limiting value to error reduction and workflow integration
Installer margins and Polish PV growth can fluctuate, creating churn and price sensitivity
Incorrect certificate or technical checks could delay or endanger a connection
Maintaining several DSO variants may become a manual rules business

structure.commercial_archetype: Per-installation submission preflight embedded in installer quoting and commissioning workflow
structure.control_point: The installer-approved technical dossier required before a microinstallation or storage-equipped system is accepted for grid connection/use
structure.critical_dependency: Current DSO-specific forms and rules, authoritative inverter/certificate status, and accurate as-built site and installer data

thesis: Planning-stage hypothesis: provide an installer-side dossier compiler and preflight engine for Polish microgeneration and storage connections across distribution-system operators. It would bind site/client facts, one-line diagrams, inverter and storage models, current NC RfG certificate status, technical sheets, installer declarations, measurements, and DSO-specific forms into a versioned project record. The gate is a complete connection notification or installation document that can be accepted without avoidable correction. A pilot inside the parents' renewable installer can measure rework and support the first product without assuming outside demand; the broader moat comes from continuously maintained DSO/device rules and error-resolution data.
title: Polish PV and Storage Grid-Dossier Preflight
uncertainties: Actual dossier preparation and correction cost in the family company and outside installers
Whether DSOs permit or expose interfaces beyond user-driven forms
Degree of commonality among PV-only, hybrid inverter, and battery-storage dossiers
Installer willingness to pay separately rather than expect the feature in quoting software
